svg.title: Architecture of the Stark Document Translator
svg.desc: Browsers, AI agents and operators talk to a FastAPI web process. Jobs go through a Huey queue on SQLite to separate worker processes that run the translation pipeline: extraction, an Analyst agent, per page a Translator agent, deterministic checks and layout measurement, a Judge agent, Refiner and Escalation agents, then rendering and a read-back of the written PDF. Workers write progress events to SQLite; the web process streams them over SSE.
svg.text: Analyst, Translator, Refiner: gpt-5.4-mini · Judge: gpt-5.4
Escalation: gpt-5.5 · structured outputs, tools, traces
full font of the same family
asyncio.run(pipeline) per job · an event after every step · cancel checked between steps
only the terms in the batch
fit measured in the real renderer
two scores (headline = the lower) · cost per call
decisions for the user → redo makes a new version
job rows; events for SSE / MCP
One job: upload or MCP call → validate → job row + queued task → worker: extract → analyse → per page translate, check, judge, refine (→ escalate) → render → read back → report.
Every step writes an event to SQLite; the web process streams it to the browser (SSE) and to MCP clients (progress notifications).
